description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically for converting strings into camelCase format. It provides functionality to handle various delimiters, whitespace, and case conversions, primarily for naming conventions within the application.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a given string to camelCase format, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace characters. Returns the original value if it’s not a string.
